notes:
### New

- Supports Antigravity more fully: its sessions and conversations, hooks, questions and approvals, new sessions, Remote control and agent messaging.
- Reads relays: add one by hand or let Agent HUD recognise it, then see its balance and prices with the key its client already uses. Each relay has its own settings page.
- Adds a price page where you can correct what a model costs.
- Records each call under the route it goes through, for Codex, Claude Code and Hermes; local routes cost nothing.
- Prices Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon and Antigravity's effort variants.
- Tags each session with where its first and latest prompts were typed, and shows them in the session's Statistics detail.
- Shows the last 24 hours for agents with no quota window or balance.
- Reads Cursor's sessions and tokens on this Mac, and Grok Bot's daily tokens per bot.
- Queues Codex messages through the command line inside Codex.app or ChatGPT.app, and opens another client's Codex thread in the Codex app.
- Lists each local-network iPhone's app version next to its name.
- Checks which of your devices run an older Agent HUD. A Mac that is behind looks for the update at once, and Settings → Subscription marks every device that is behind.

### Fixes

- Lists sessions by their last message.
- Sends iPhone and Apple Watch messages to Claude Code as your own words, and records the HUD's answers as sent from the Mac.
- Keeps a client's settings file as it was when Agent HUD edits it, and no longer re-sorts `~/.claude.json`.
- Says why Codex has no ChatGPT plan limits, and tells you to update Claude Code when it is too old for the plugin. Brings an installed Claude plugin up to date at launch.
- Shows what priced calls cost when some calls have no list price.
- Reads each log once for both its tokens and its conversation, looks at held logs every 3 seconds, and watches only the folders it reads.
- Streams local-network changes to the iPhone as they happen.
- Hides and orders panel rows by the keys layouts carry over.
